recent_posts.summary: A developer shares a browser-based 3D game built entirely by GPT-5.5 in a single prompt using Three.js, highlighting how the result feels genuinely fun and playable compared to earlier AI-generated games. The smooth controls and procedurally generated shapes are noted as standout qualities, and the game was featured on OpenAI's GPT-5.5 release page.

recent_posts.title:
Also, a detail some of you may have missed:

Anthropic’s gated Mythos model scored 83% on CyberGym.

OpenAI just dropped GPT-5.5 at 82%.

Except GPT-5.5 is actually available for people to use.
recent_posts.summary: Anthropic's gated Mythos model scored 83% on the CyberGym benchmark, narrowly beating OpenAI's GPT-5.5 which scored 82%. The post highlights that GPT-5.5 is publicly available while Mythos remains gated, implying a practical advantage for OpenAI despite the slightly lower benchmark score.

recent_posts.title:
GPT-5.5 is the highest leverage tool I have ever touched.

For the first time, I don’t feel limited by what a model can do. I feel limited only by what I can imagine.

Training workflows. Impossible optimizations. Hardware experiments over USB.

The vibe hardware era begins.
recent_posts.summary: A brief, enthusiastic take on GPT-5.5 as a transformative tool for hardware experimentation and workflow optimization. The author claims it removes capability limitations, leaving only imagination as the bottleneck, and declares the start of a 'vibe hardware era.'

recent_posts.title:
Ok this is actually pretty impressive and I truly didn't see any model doing this before or being able to do it to this extent.

When I asked Muse Spark from Meta to convert this image into code, it cut out the assets from the screens so it could use them correctly!
recent_posts.summary: Meta's Muse Spark model demonstrated an impressive capability: when asked to convert a UI screenshot into code, it automatically extracted and isolated assets from the screen images to use them correctly in the generated code. The author highlights this as a novel behavior not seen in other models before.
